CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (color at a named record), its organization/access metadata (origin), and a separate status attribute are all explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (color) and explicit temporal tags are present.

D.rationale: Origin/metadata fields separately state provenance/status distinct from the content coordinate lists.

O.rationale: Organization/access is described both by per-item origin metadata and by an explicit spatial-layout statement.
